# downsocial Private Video Downloader — Full AI Architecture Specification

## 1. System Objective
Provide end-users who are authorized friends, followers, or group members with a completely web-browser-based, zero-installation method to extract and download high-definition (1080p Full HD) MP4 videos and MP3 audio from Facebook Private Profiles, Facebook Closed/Secret Groups, and Instagram Private Accounts without ever transmitting their account passwords, credentials, or session cookies to third-party servers.

## 2. Technical Challenge & Root Cause
Meta (Facebook & Instagram) safeguards private video assets by requiring authenticated session identifiers (e.g. `c_user`, `xs`, `sessionid`) on every HTTP GET request.
When standard online video downloaders attempt to fetch a private URL, Meta's edge proxies return:
- HTTP 403 Forbidden
- HTTP 302 Found (Redirect to Login)

No third-party scraper can legally or technically bypass this server-side restriction without an authenticated session.

## 3. The Web Browser Page Source Solution
When an authorized user loads the private video in their own web browser (Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Microsoft Edge, Apple Safari, Brave, or Samsung Internet):
1. The user's browser authenticates directly with Meta via TLS.
2. Meta validates the user's friend/follower status and delivers the HTML response containing the temporary, signed media tokens (`fbcdn.net`, `cdninstagram.com`).
3. The user views the HTML source code (`Ctrl + U` on desktop, or `view-source:<URL>` on mobile web browsers).
4. The user copies this HTML and pastes it into downsocial Private Downloader.
5. downsocial's parser regex extracts the direct signed CDN media streams.
6. The user selects HD MP4 (1080p), SD MP4 (720p), or MP3 audio.
7. downsocial's streaming endpoint (`/api/direct`) verifies the CDN host in its authorized whitelist and proxies the media stream with `Content-Disposition: attachment`, prompting a native browser save dialog.

## 4. Supported Private Video Types
- Facebook Personal Profile Videos (Friends Only)
- Facebook Closed & Secret Group Videos
- Facebook Private Watch & Live Streams (Replays)
- Instagram Private Account Reels
- Instagram Private Posts with Embedded Video

## 5. Security & Fair Use Compliance
- Zero Log Policy: Neither the pasted HTML nor the video files are stored on downsocial servers.
- Zero Credential Exposure: Users never provide passwords or authentication cookies.
- Personal Archival: Intended strictly for legitimate fair-use personal offline backup of content the user already has permission to view.
